description: The basic edition provides only fundamental chart rendering. IIChartBasic is the basic edition of the native MFC/Win32 chart control that ports Apache ECharts through WebView2, supporting both x86 and x64 platforms. Official website: https://www.xw-industrial.com/ ; Github: https://github.com/XuweiIntelligentTechnology/IIChart
summary: WebView2 + ECharts chart control for MFC/Win32 native C++ projects (Basic edition, x86/x64).
title: IIChartBasic (Intelligent Industrial Chart Control - Basic Edition)
